skills.name: agent-skill-router
skills.description: Select a specialized repository workflow when an engineering request does not name a skill. Skip additional skills when ordinary coding judgment is sufficient.
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $agent-skill-router to choose the best skills for the current engineering task.

skills.name: agentic-engineering
skills.description: Build and review tool-using agents and durable agent workflows. Use for control flow, tool contracts, memory, recovery, budgets, and delegation decisions; not ordinary AI-assisted coding.
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $agentic-engineering to design the smallest reliable tool-using workflow with explicit state, permissions, budgets, and recovery.

skills.name: api-review
skills.description: Review API contracts for compatibility, auth, pagination, idempotency, and error semantics. Use for proposed interfaces or contract changes, rather than handler implementation.
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $api-review to review API contracts, behavior, and compatibility.

skills.name: api-writer
skills.description: Implement route handlers and controllers for an established API contract, including input validation, authorization, error mapping, and response serialization.
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $api-writer to implement API handlers and contracts.

skills.name: code-documentation
skills.description: Write or review README content, API documentation, architecture notes, or operational instructions. Use when documentation is a requested deliverable or behavior changes make existing docs stale.
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $code-documentation to create or review useful code documentation.

skills.name: code-review
skills.description: Review diffs, PRs, or worktrees for concrete bugs and regressions. Use adversarial review for risky production paths or when the user asks to grill a change.
skills.shortDescription: Review or grill changes for production risk
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $code-review to review or adversarially grill these changes and lead with findings.

skills.name: commit-pr-writer
skills.description: Draft commit messages, PR descriptions, or release notes from verified diffs and test results. Use when delivery text is requested; do not commit or publish implicitly.
skills.shortDescription: Write commit messages and PR text
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $commit-pr-writer to create commit messages and PR descriptions from changes.

skills.name: critical-thinking
skills.description: Challenge a proposed engineering approach when evidence suggests unsafe tradeoffs, speculative complexity, or conflicting constraints. Skip routine implementation with no disputed design decision.
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $critical-thinking to challenge assumptions and reject anti-pattern designs when needed.

skills.name: database-schema-design
skills.description: Design or review schema changes, constraints, indexes, data lifecycle, and migration rollout. Use when durable data shape or migration behavior changes, rather than for every database query.
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $database-schema-design to design or review database tables and entities.

skills.name: decision-memory
skills.description: Search or record repository decisions with rationale, evidence, and supersession using the bundled local ledger. Use for explicit decision records or changes that revisit a prior decision.
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $decision-memory to record or retrieve the relevant engineering decision.

skills.name: design-principles-review
skills.description: Review abstraction quality, dependency direction, and module ownership in an architecture or refactor. Use for disputed boundaries or unnecessary complexity, rather than routine edits.
skills.shortDescription: Check SOLID YAGNI and design risks
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $design-principles-review to review design principles, abstractions, and maintainability.

skills.name: doc-template-writer
skills.description: Create a fill-in Markdown PRD, project brief, RFC, or engineering design template from the bundled assets. Use when the user wants a template, rather than a completed strategy.
skills.shortDescription: Create product and engineering doc templates
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $doc-template-writer to create a focused Markdown document template.

skills.name: dribbble-design
skills.description: Develop frontend design directions from Dribbble references, screenshots, or existing UI. Use for visual inspiration, moodboards, hierarchy, typography, and design critiques; not mechanical frontend fixes.
skills.shortDescription: Turn visual inspiration into usable frontend design
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $dribbble-design to research visual references and recommend a distinctive, usable frontend direction for this screen.

skills.name: graph-engineering
skills.description: Design and review knowledge graphs, dependency graphs, and GraphRAG pipelines. Use for entity identity, provenance, temporal facts, traversal, or graph retrieval quality; not workflow orchestration.
skills.shortDescription: Design grounded graphs and graph retrieval
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $graph-engineering to design a grounded graph model and retrieval pipeline with provenance, freshness, and baseline evaluation.

skills.name: harness-engineering
skills.description: Design and improve coding-agent environments, feedback loops, and evaluation harnesses. Use for reproducibility, task verification, context handoffs, or measured agent reliability.
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $harness-engineering to improve the agent environment and independently measure task completion against a fixed baseline.

skills.name: implementation-plan
skills.description: Plan changes with meaningful sequencing, migration, rollout, or validation dependencies. Use when a plan is requested or execution needs coordination; skip formal plans for straightforward edits.
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $implementation-plan to inspect the project and create a practical implementation plan.

skills.name: incident-response
skills.description: Triage production degradation and assess mitigation, rollback, or hotfix options. Use during an active incident or when preparing its post-mortem.
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $incident-response to triage this production incident.

skills.name: macos-reminder
skills.description: Schedule local macOS notifications with the bundled launchd script. Use for reminder requests with a message and due time; clarify missing or ambiguous timing.
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $macos-reminder to schedule a local macOS reminder notification.

skills.name: observability-design
skills.description: Design or audit service logs, metrics, traces, SLOs, dashboards, and alerts. Use for instrumentation changes, telemetry gaps, logging noise, or actionable paging.
skills.shortDescription: Design logs, metrics, traces, and alerts
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $observability-design to add appropriate structured logs and telemetry to this service.

skills.name: product-communication
skills.description: Draft stakeholder or customer messages that communicate disagreement, tradeoffs, status, or decisions respectfully and firmly. Use for substantive product communication, rather than every short reply.
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $product-communication to draft or send respectful, firm product communication.

skills.name: product-competitive-thinking
skills.description: Evaluate startup product bets, MVP scope, onboarding, pricing, or competitor-driven requests. Use when user value, differentiation, or learning needs a decision, rather than every UI edit.
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $product-competitive-thinking to evaluate product decisions from PM and competitor viewpoints.

skills.name: repository-map
skills.description: Generate or refresh a repository file and symbol map using bundled scripts. Use for broad discovery in an unfamiliar or large repository; skip mapping when the relevant files are already known.
skills.shortDescription: Map repository files and symbols for broad discovery
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $repository-map to generate compact project context and a file map when broad discovery is needed; enrich only when useful.

skills.name: security-review
skills.description: Review changed trust boundaries for reachable security and privacy failures: auth, tenant isolation, secrets, uploads, webhooks, injection, and dependency trust.
skills.shortDescription: Find exploitable security and privacy risks
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $security-review to review this change for concrete security and privacy vulnerabilities.

skills.name: self-amending-skill
skills.description: Maintain skills, triggers, routing, and supporting validation when requested or when usage reveals a concrete failure. Use for evidence-backed skill changes, rather than unrelated feature work.
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $self-amending-skill to update skills based on concrete usage evidence.

skills.name: service-writer
skills.description: Implement business workflows with transaction, permission, retry, and external side-effect boundaries. Use for application orchestration that needs explicit failure handling.
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $service-writer to implement focused service-layer behavior.

skills.name: test-design-review
skills.description: Review test adequacy, false confidence, mocks, flakiness, and missing risk coverage. Use when test strategy is uncertain or a test review is requested, rather than every test edit.
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $test-design-review to design tests or review test quality and coverage.

skills.name: upskilling-research
skills.description: Curate verified learning resources and a practical learning path. Use when the user asks to study a domain, upskill, or find current technical reading and talks.
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $upskilling-research to research fresh learning resources and create a focused upskilling plan.

skills.name: work-impact-tracker
skills.description: Record evidence-backed accomplishments or generate appraisal summaries using the bundled private local worklog. Use for brag documents, work-impact capture, and performance reviews.
skills.shortDescription: Track work and prepare appraisal summaries
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $work-impact-tracker to record my work or summarize my impact for an appraisal.

skills.name: wtf-check
skills.description: Reset work when there is observable thrash, repeated failure without new evidence, scope drift, or a contradiction with the active goal. Use for a concrete course correction, rather than routine uncertainty.
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $wtf-check to challenge drift, thrash, overbuilding, and reset to the smallest useful next move.
